publication issues.summary: The original current canonical V3 remains the proposed source without changes: Inputs/Baseline model.json, Baseline raw.json (deterministically restored, not an independent acquisition), and Baseline.txt. The inverse and forward source diffs are empty because no edit was justified. V4 baseline/AP061.json is an actual conversion draft with its paired review/AP/AP061.json and AP061.txt. It is partial, unapproved and contains unresolved findings; it is not an installation or publication. The baseline inputs and every existing claim, null and alias are retained; no physical pin is inferred from a partial character. All 61 recorded route panels (including three decorative title-frame routes), 20 junctions and 19 unjoined crossings were visually viewed using overlapping native/overlay crops. The route panels sample endpoints, bends and intermediate positions at no more than 10 character columns horizontally or 5 rows vertically; the crops overlap. This is a sampled visual attempt, not a continuous electrical trace, and cannot prove that missing original wires or undocumented connections do not exist. The per-record inventory and limitations are in Visual coverage ledger.json. Original scan overview and route/point panels are retained; no scan paintover or electrical reconnection was performed. No source-supported local move was sufficiently established for adoption. Alignment analysis/Manual composite.png is a block-seeded registered native scan in red and canonical V3 text in blue. The block fit used manually seeded native anchors and model-derived corners: 45 inliers of 52, median residual 1.59 render pixels; this is candidate-dependent and cannot independently establish source block geometry. Edge alignment used detected text after the block registration, 17 inliers of 21 and 0.59 pixel median, with four outliers (edge differences 5.8–30.6 pixels); text matching may match repeated labels and is not a fully independent scan registration. Both transforms and edge anchor panels are saved. General small offsets and imperfect scan strokes remain; no whole-column shift was adopted. V4 composite.png is independently rendered V4 text in blue with the same registered scan r Native/electrical, full tracing and omission remain limited; no approval inferred.
